_comment: Replay fixture for the BTK inhibitor query. NX-5948 is intentionally omitted (asset recall < 100%); the final claim cites a non-retrieved source and is dropped by the guard.

assets.indication: CLL/SLL, MCL, WM, marginal zone lymphoma, chronic GVHD
assets.latest_readout: RESONATE (NCT01578707): PFS and OS benefit vs ofatumumab in R/R CLL (NEJM 2014); first-in-class, approved 2013.

assets.mechanism: Covalent irreversible, second-generation and more selective (binds Cys481)
assets.latest_readout: ELEVATE-TN (NCT02475681) superior PFS in treatment-naive CLL (Lancet 2020); ELEVATE-RR non-inferior to ibrutinib with less atrial fibrillation.

assets.mechanism: Covalent irreversible, second-generation and more selective (binds Cys481)
assets.indication: CLL/SLL, MCL, WM, marginal zone lymphoma
assets.latest_readout: ALPINE (NCT03734016): SUPERIOR PFS vs ibrutinib in R/R CLL — first BTKi to beat ibrutinib head-to-head (NEJM 2023); SEQUOIA superiority vs BR.

assets.mechanism: Non-covalent reversible inhibitor (Cys481-independent; active against C481S-mutant disease)
assets.indication: R/R MCL, R/R CLL/SLL (post covalent BTKi)
assets.latest_readout: BRUIN (NCT03740529): durable responses in heavily pretreated and C481S-mutant disease (Lancet 2021); accelerated approvals 2023.

assets.mechanism: Non-covalent reversible inhibitor (active against C481S and gatekeeper mutations)
assets.indication: R/R CLL/SLL and other B-cell malignancies
assets.latest_readout: BELLWAVE-001 (NCT03162536) responses across BTKi-resistant disease; phase 3 BELLWAVE program ongoing (C481S activity, Cancer Discovery 2018).
Phase 1/2 in R/R PCNSL (Neuro-Oncology 2021); Japan approval 2020.

assets.mechanism: BTK degrader (CDAC chimeric degradation-activating compound; CRBN-recruiting)
assets.latest_readout: CaDAnCe-101 (NCT05006716) responses in covalent/non-covalent-BTKi-resistant disease; phase 3 vs pirtobrutinib (NCT06973187).

narrative_claims.text: Three covalent BTK inhibitors are approved for B-cell malignancies: ibrutinib (first-in-class), acalabrutinib and zanubrutinib.
In the head-to-head ALPINE trial, zanubrutinib demonstrated superior progression-free survival versus ibrutinib in relapsed/refractory CLL — the first BTKi to beat ibrutinib.
Acalabrutinib showed non-inferior PFS to ibrutinib with significantly less atrial fibrillation in ELEVATE-RR, reflecting its greater BTK selectivity.
Pirtobrutinib is a non-covalent, Cys481-independent BTK inhibitor that retains activity against C481S-mutant, covalent-BTKi-resistant disease and is approved in R/R MCL and CLL/SLL.
BTK degraders such as BeiGene's BGB-16673 aim to overcome both Cys481 and kinase-dead resistance, and are now in phase 3 versus pirtobrutinib.
Nemtabrutinib (Merck, MK-1026) is a reversible BTK inhibitor active against C481S and gatekeeper mutations, in phase 3 development.
Tirabrutinib is approved in Japan and is differentiated by activity in primary CNS lymphoma.
BTK (ENSG00000010671) is the central validated target across CLL, mantle cell lymphoma and other B-cell malignancies in Open Targets.
Pirtobrutinib is a covalent irreversible inhibitor that binds Cys481.
